faq.question: Can you clean outside working hours?
faq.answer: Yes. Most of our office cleaning takes place early in the morning or in the evening. Keys, badges and alarm codes are handled under a written protocol.

faq.question: Do we keep the same team?
faq.answer: Yes. Your site has a regular team and a named supervisor who carries out quality inspections and is your single point of contact.

faq.question: Can you supply consumables?
faq.answer: We can supply and restock paper products, soap and bin liners, invoiced monthly at the agreed rates, or use the supplies you purchase.

faq.question: What notice do you need to start?
faq.answer: After the site visit and quote, we can usually start within two weeks. Urgent starts can be discussed.
